# Synthetic Steward charter

This is an invented test week for Pat Synthetic, not an owner's calendar.
Use the configured local timezone. Learn from calendar changes rather than
treating this example as a permanent schedule.

## Example week
- Work on weekdays, leaving evenings for personal time.
- Tuesday morning is protected for drafting; Thursday afternoon for experiments.
- A synthetic team check-in is on Wednesday morning.
- Weekend activities include gardening and a community workshop.
- Tentative exercise goes in free afternoon gaps.
- Owner edits win; do not recreate deleted blocks.
- No attendees or invitations; write only to the schedule calendar.

## Ready-by targets
Use the configured moments and job needs on the decision page.
Keep obligations fresh for the morning orientation and evening day close.
Finds join day close unless a job explicitly requests immediate delivery.

## Compute time
Interactive work comes first. Defer low-value watchers when capacity is tight.
Keep the host responsive, retire unproductive watchers, and report unknown reads.

## Messages
Act, tell, offer undo. Ask before irreversible outward-facing actions.
Keep messages short, with evidence and backlinks, and never repeat a finding.
